purpose: Teach: マタイ/カンジ/エッセンス/面々/国崎/土屋/大森/樋口

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新約聖書のマタイ伝の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with textual research on the Gospel of Matthew in the New Testament, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. A gentle confirmation wrapped as a question. Opens with his name like she's inviting him into conversation, not testing him. Steady pace, approachable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、日本語のカンジ、つまり漢字の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the history of kanji—Chinese characters in Japanese.
lines.style: Straightforward, a little formal. He's caught in the mismatch and correcting respectfully. Slight pause before he launches into his actual topic, as if gathering himself. Even-toned, careful.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、和食のエッセンス、つまり日本料理の本質研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper explored the essence of washoku—the fundamental nature of Japanese cuisine, didn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, observant. She's noticing something. Opens with warmth but there's a careful quality underneath, like she's paying closer attention this time. Measured pace, inviting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、研究者面々のご意見をまとめた論文を執筆しました
lines.en: Yes, I compiled and synthesized the various perspectives of researchers in the field.
lines.style: Still earnest but noticeably frustrated now. He knows something is off. Speaks with precision, almost mechanically. The correction is sharper but still respectful. A hint of strain in the evenness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宇佐神宮の国崎、つまり国東半島の地理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper focused on geographic research of Kunisaki Peninsula—the area around Usa Shrine, didn't it?
lines.style: Patient, steady warmth. She's watching him carefully now. Her tone hasn't changed—still kind—but there's something knowing in how she frames the question. Deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、考古学者土屋先生の発掘成果を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the excavation findings and archaeological work of Professor Tsuchiya.
lines.style: Exhaustion starting to show. Still correct and composed, but there's a tightness now. He's realized the pattern. Speaks with precision but less energy. The 'yes' carries slight resignation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、貝類研究家大森博士のご研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper drew on the research of Dr. Omori, the malacologist—the shellfish specialist, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm but unmistakably deliberate now. She knows. She's being kind about it. The rhythm is patient, giving him space to understand. Each phrase lands clearly but without judgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、言語学者樋口先生の方言研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I analyzed dialectal research conducted by Professor Higuchi, a linguist.
lines.style: Quiet acceptance. He understands now what she's been doing. Still earnest, still respectful, but there's a completeness to his tone—almost like relief at finally understanding the test. Closes cleanly, no trailing uncertainty.
